channels.name: Reddit r/SideProject

channels.name: Existing YouTube educational channel
channels.restrictions: Useful original demonstration; no repetitive mass-produced videos, misleading diversion, comment spam or artificial engagement.
channels.measurement: demo source visits; preview and checkout event ratios
channels.score_basis: Editorial prioritization; not observed traffic, demand or predicted revenue

channels.name: Indie Hackers community
channels.restrictions: Audience fit is a hypothesis. Guidelines page was inaccessible; no authoritative permission verified. Recheck current community rules and AI policy before any submission.
channels.measurement: manual approval and relevant responses before traffic test
channels.score_basis: Editorial prioritization; not observed traffic, demand or predicted revenue

channels.name: Existing consenting peer or educator
channels.restrictions: No actual partner identified or contacted. Ask owner to select an existing consenting relationship; agree educational scope. No affiliate or commission scheme authorized.
channels.measurement: opt-in feedback and separately tagged placement if mutually approved
channels.score_basis: Editorial prioritization; not observed traffic, demand or predicted revenue

channels.name: Pinterest original visual checklist
channels.restrictions: Current policy prohibits unapproved automation and spam; confirm effective policy on publication date (page announces a November 12 2026 update).
channels.measurement: tagged preview visits; no guaranteed niche demand
channels.score_basis: Editorial prioritization; not observed traffic, demand or predicted revenue

channels.name: Product Hunt directory launch
channels.restrictions: Free launch through personal account. Novelty/fit uncertain for general template material. No paid hunters, vote solicitation, fake engagement. Do not create account without approval.
channels.measurement: qualified referral visits and real orders; featuring not guaranteed
channels.score_basis: Editorial prioritization; not observed traffic, demand or predicted revenue

channels.restrictions: Local rules page returned an empty shell; do not infer commercial promotion or research permission. Audience need is unvalidated.
channels.measurement: no campaign until specific permission verified

channels.name: Reddit r/smallbusiness
channels.restrictions: Page inaccessible during review. Broad audience fit weak; do not post promotion or invitations until exact current rules verified.

channels.restrictions: Sidebar prohibits AI-generated posts/comments and standalone promotion. Weekly designated threads do not override AI prohibition. No generated drafts here; no disguised promotion.
